instruction: A candid full-shot photograph from an eye-level angle shows an indoor martial arts studio with wooden walls and a black mat. In the center-right, the martial artist in the black gi (R1) is kneeling, leaning forward to control the partner's leg. On the left, the martial artist in the pink gi (R2) lies on her back, facing up with her legs raised. The martial artist in the black gi (R1) holds the leg of the martial artist in the pink gi (R2) to secure a grappling position. The scene is illuminated by warm indoor lighting with natural tones.
